# Cross-lab edges and background reading

## Cross-lab edges

Ten working habits that run under every lab, each with a prompt you can copy.

**The working edges**: Five habits the labs build and five extras, including how to set up a session and how to make your usage last. Keep it open while you work.

## Background reading

If you want the whole picture. These pages were written for the program team, so some of the wording is aimed at them.

**Curriculum map**: The seven-lab design: what each week covers and how the weeks build on each other.

**Invitation and seat confirmation**: Already done if you arrived here from your confirmation email. It holds the readiness quiz and the form your organization used to confirm its two seats.
